title: CarrierBookingConfirmed
description: A Carrier confirmed a Requested Carrier booking with its own booking reference and, optionally, a planned collection time (Canonical Model event, version 1). The Carrier booking became Confirmed and the Shipment Booked; the Shipment's move carries no event of its own. Published on the Shipment events topic, under the correlation ID of the answer, which API Management creates.

occurredAt.description: When the Carrier's confirmation was recorded.

correlationId.description: The answer's own correlation ID, not the release's.

carrierBookingNumber.description: The Carrier booking the Carrier confirmed.

shipmentNumber.description: The Shipment the Carrier booking covers, now Booked.

transportOrderNumber.description: The Transport Order the Shipment carries out.

carrierId.description: The Carrier that confirmed the booking.

carrierBookingReference.description: The Carrier's own reference for the booking.

plannedCollectionTime.description: When the Carrier plans to collect, if it gave one.
